current_milestone.title: Bounded n8n orchestration over the same ResearchForge backend
current_milestone.outcome: Phase 3 is green and published on main. Phase 4 local gates passed: real n8n three-filing artifact equality, bounded failure routing, 192 backend tests and Web E2E. Public Phase 4 CI is pending.

commands.command: uv lock --check; ruff format/check; mypy --strict; pytest -q; validate_contracts.py
commands.summary: Local gate passed: 192 backend tests, 88 strictly typed source files, 8 V1.5 schemas and all three persisted n8n outputs. Existing frozen package tests remain green.

commands.command: npm lint/typecheck/test/build; Playwright mocked E2E and live-backend E2E
commands.summary: Four frontend unit tests, two mocked and three live-backend journeys passed with no critical accessibility errors. Local E2E uses installed Chrome via PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH; default downloaded browser was unavailable.

commands.command: Docker Compose build/up; docker_smoke.py; Alembic downgrade base/upgrade head; docker_smoke.py
commands.summary: All three PostgreSQL-backed filing cases succeeded before and after migration round-trip; each exposed six facts, four calculations, monitoring and ten trace stages.
All three ignored official PDFs reproduced package/recovery hashes; published 3 actual Research Results with zero deterministic Verifier failures and zero provider calls.

commands.command: n8n import/publish; python -m scripts.n8n_smoke; failure-fixture; Node tests and ESLint
commands.summary: Actual n8n 2.37.9 passed three real filing cases with five artifact families identical to backend, minimum input, replay, five real HTTP failures, five transport-only runtime scenarios and eight Node test groups.

next_action.title: Finish the n8n engineering checkpoint, then harden the product/demo

acceptance_evidence: Three actual n8n filing runs preserve all backend artifacts and presentation aliases.
Input, namespace, idempotency, waiting, timeout and terminal failure paths are explicit and tested.
Backend, contracts, frontend E2E, Docker/n8n runtime and GitHub CI pass.
Proceed directly to Phase 5 without an intermediate independent reviewer.

last_session.summary: Published Phase 3 after green CI; implemented and locally verified same-backend n8n integration without core changes or intermediate independent acceptance. Phase 4 public CI is next; human validation remains deferred.
